items.title: Realising an inverse system of derived objects by a filtered complex
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file injectives.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: The lemma shows that an inverse system of objects of the derived category of a Grothendieck abelian category mapping compatibly to a fixed object is realised by a filtered complex whose filtration steps represent the terms of the system (statement lines 2601-2615). The proof is a complete argument: a K-injective representative with injective terms is chosen (proof lines 2617-2620), the terms of the system are represented by complexes in both directions (proof lines 2621-2634), the representing maps are made compatible by correcting them with lifted homotopies, which is where injectivity of the terms is used (proof lines 2634-2652), acyclic K-injective replacements are built by mapping to the cone on the identity (proof lines 2654-2672), and the product diagram is shown to represent the given system using the product rule for K-injective complexes (proof lines 2674-2701). The non-formal content is the homotopy lifting and the assembly of the product diagram. The claim is H3.
